editorial:
You're dropped into a wild ride from the very first scene. Nick is a slacker pizza delivery guy whose ordinary night turns into a nightmare when two bumbling criminals kidnap him, strap a bomb to his chest, and give him just hours to rob a bank. With his best friend Chet reluctantly dragged along, the duo stumbles through a chaotic plan that mixes panic, friendship, and dark humor. The movie keeps things light and fast, never letting the tension get too heavy, so you're laughing even when things look dangerous.

Jesse Eisenberg and Aziz Ansari have great buddy chemistry, and Danny McBride steals scenes as the loud, clueless villain. The action is quick and the jokes land often, though the plot is thin and some gags feel forced. If you want a short, silly comedy with a few thrills, this is a fun pick. Stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for your collection.
endingExplained: Nick and Chet successfully rob the bank and hand the cash to Dwayne and Travis. But Dwayne's strict military father shows up with a gun, sparking a shootout where Travis is killed. Dwayne escapes with the money, while Nick and Chet survive and the bomb is safely removed. In a post-credits scene, Dwayne is living it up in Mexico, while Nick and Chet return to normal life, keeping some of the cash.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves buddy comedies with a wild crime twist.
